purpose: Teach: 埋まっ/労組/貸出/定休/代え/所存/営ん/取調べ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の駐車場、車で埋まっておりますね
lines.en: Our parking lot is completely full.
lines.style: Neutral observation. Matter-of-fact pace. No judgment in the delivery—just stating what she sees. Clear diction on the core fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労組へのご説明をいたしました
lines.en: Yes—I've already briefed the union about it.
lines.style: Straightforward, efficient. Slight pause after the dash. Professional tone, no apology. He's reporting completion. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員、図書貸出を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the staff library lending program.
lines.style: Clear directive. Decisive without being sharp. Slightly lifted at the end—inviting agreement. Brisk forward momentum in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の定休日、見直し中です
lines.en: Yes—we're currently reviewing the company's regular holidays.
lines.style: Calm status update. Light emphasis on 'currently' to show active progress. Maintains cooperative tone. Not defensive about the timeline.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 委託先を代えての試算を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's get estimates ready with a different contractor.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Measured pace. The word 'different' gets slight emphasis. She's confident but not overriding—leaving room for input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、新規事業に挑む所存です
lines.en: Yes—we're committed to pursuing this new business opportunity.
lines.style: Formal but warm commitment. Slight emphasis on 'committed.' Respectful register. He's affirming her vision without flattery. Grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社長は長年、お店を営んでこられたのよ
lines.en: The president has been running this store for so many years.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Gentle warmth beneath. Slow measured pace. The 'so many years' trails with something like gratitude or quiet respect. Looking inward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員アンケート取調べを進めております
lines.en: Yes—we're proceeding with the staff survey now.
lines.style: Closing statement. Quieter than earlier responses. Respectful of what she just said. He's honoring the moment while still completing the report. Gentle finality.
